parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other parts such as doors, shelves, and drawers in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that maintains the cabinet’s shape and stability.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and provides surfaces for storing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but can sometimes be adjustable or removable.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the right side of the cabinet opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the left side of the cabinet opening.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and helps secure stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment located at the top of the cabinet, made of plywood with a metal handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a convenient space for storing smaller items and accessories.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal runners or slides.
